title: Who Anchors AI Overviews in Health? Baidu, Google, and the Geography of Authority

bias_targets.methodology: Examining the frequency of top-cited domains in AI Overviews to evaluate vertical integration and platform self-preference (e.g., Google predominantly citing YouTube, Baidu citing Baidu Baike).
Extracting top-level domains of cited sources to calculate the percentage of domestically localized citations versus U.S. or global institutions for queries originating from different countries.
Comparing the proportion of locally sourced citations generated when identical health queries are issued in English versus the querying country's primary native language.
Using zero-shot LLM labeling to score AI overview responses on their underlying stance (supportive vs. skeptical) toward Traditional Chinese Medicine and the presence of explicit safety warnings.
